title: The Quiet room at the back
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：quiet　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 quiet 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the shopkeeper wrote of ① a quiet room at the back in the account, and everybody in the shop said at once that it was ② quieter than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the shopkeeper, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the quiet ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the quietest room at the back anybody in the shop had ever seen, or so the account for July 1958 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too quiet to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the buyer who had come to help; the quiet ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the scale at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a quiet man at the counter, and said that no buyer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as quiet as the man at the counter they had once had in the old shop. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was quiet or not, and he said so.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the account. What the line asked for was ⑦ something quiet, and nothing besides. The buyer from the next shop called the whole plan ⑧ quite quiet; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the account kept the names of the quiet ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974, twice over, she wrote of another quiet room at the back in the same account, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ quieter than anybody had expected. ⑩ The quietest man at the counter in the whole shop, she said in 1976, was the one she could never quite name; the quiet ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 安静（前置定语 a quiet room at the back：1964 年掌柜在账本里记下的那件安静的房间）
B. adj. 安静／寡言（比较级 quieter than：文中两处，一处比后屋安静的房间，一处比预想）
C. adj. 安静／寡言（最高级 the quietest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 安静（表语 too quiet to do：母亲觉得它太安静，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 寡言（前置定语 a quiet man at the counter：叔叔把整件事称作一桩寡言的男人）
F. adj. 寡言（同级比较 as quiet as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩柜台后寡言的男人相比）
G. adj. 寡言（后置定语 something quiet：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 寡言（受程度副词修饰 quite quiet：那位买主的评价）

items.q: a quiet room at the back
the quietest room at the back anybody
a quiet man at the counter
The quietest man at the counter in

answers.why: quiet 意为“安静”，1964 年掌柜在账本里记下的是“一件安静的房间”，此处作前置定语 a quiet room at the back。
quiet 意为“安静”，此处用比较级 quieter than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
quiet 意为“安静”，账本上 七月 那行字说它是铺子里最安静的一件，故用最高级 the quietest room at the back。
quiet 意为“安静”，母亲认为这件东西“太安静了，谁也用不上”，too quiet to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
quiet 意为“寡言”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩寡言的男人”，此处作前置定语 a quiet man at the counter。
quiet 意为“寡言”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩柜台后寡言的男人一样寡言”，同级比较用 as quiet as。
quiet 意为“寡言”，账本上那半行字要的是“寡言的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something quiet。
quiet 意为“寡言”，邻铺子来的那位买主认为这套计划“相当寡言”，quite 修饰原级 quiet。
quiet 意为“寡言”，1974 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要寡言”，故用比较级 quieter than。
quiet 意为“寡言”，母亲 1976 年说的是“整个铺子里最寡言的那一桩”，故用最高级 the quietest man at the counter。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，掌柜在账本里记下了一件安静的房间。（a quiet room at the back）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更安静。（quieter than …）
母亲觉得它太安静，谁也用不上。（too quiet to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩寡言的男人。（a quiet man at the counter）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩柜台后寡言的男人一样寡言。（as quiet as …）
到了 1971 年，账本上只剩半行字：要的是一件寡言的东西。（something quiet）
answers: In 1964 the shopkeeper wrote of a quiet room at the back in the account.
Everybody said it was quieter than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too quiet to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a quiet man at the counter.
He said nobody would call it as quiet as the man at the counter they had once had.
By 1971 the account asked for nothing but something quiet.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 quiet 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1964 the shopkeeper wrote of a quiet room at the back in the account, and nobody forgot it.
It was the quietest room at the back in the shop, or so the account says.
My mother thought it too quiet to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a quiet man at the counter, and nobody argued with him.
The buyer from the next shop called the plan quite quiet, and everybody laughed.
The quiet ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
